svg.title: One Microsoft Entra tenant with several brands, each with its own environment subscriptions and billing unit
svg.desc: Left: a billing hierarchy with one billing unit per brand: a department and account for an Enterprise Agreement, or an invoice section for a Microsoft customer agreement. Right: one Microsoft Entra tenant with one archetype management group, for example Corp. Inside it, Brand A and Brand B each have three subscriptions: Production, Test and Development. Arrows connect each brand billing unit to its row of subscriptions. A note says environments are separate subscriptions, not separate management groups. Icons are official: Azure Subscriptions, Management groups and Microsoft Entra ID.
svg.text: Separate billing comes from the billing
Extra tenants only for requirements one tenant cannot meet.
